caseName: City of New York v. Seawall Associates
caseNameFull: City of New York v. Seawall Associates

opinions.text:
Ct. App. N. Y. Application for stay, presented to Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, denied, and the order heretofore entered by Justice Marshall on July 20, 1989, is vacated.

Justice Brennan and Justice Marshall would grant the application for stay.
